html:
tokentrim 3‑machine limit

Yes, tokentrim can run on up to three machines with the Pro plan. Install the full toolkit, enable the hosted dashboard, and the same token‑saving hooks work on each device.

How it works for three machines

  1. Purchase the Pro monthly ($9/month) or lifetime ($49) license.
  2. Install tokentrim on each computer (Python 3.9+, git clone or plugin).
  3. Log into the hosted dashboard; it syncs your token‑budget, daily guard, and replay data across all three machines.
  4. Use Claude Code as usual; the compaction window and output trimming run locally, while the dashboard shows a unified view.

What you get and the cost

  • Free core: all hooks, three strength profiles, replay command, local dashboard, daily budget guard, cold‑cache alert.
  • Pro add‑ons (once you pay): hosted dashboard accessible from any device, Monday digest, weekly budget alert at 80 % usage, Slack totals, support for up to 3 machines.
  • Pricing: $9 per month or a one‑time $49 for the first 500 buyers.
  • No data leaves your machine unless you enable the hosted dashboard.

FAQ

What does the “3‑machine limit” mean? It caps the number of devices that can share a single Pro license to three. Each device runs the same local hooks; the dashboard aggregates their usage.

Do I still get token savings on each machine? Yes. The full install provides the compaction window, which on the author’s 135 conversations cut history re‑read by 75 % and extended limits by 4.0×. Output trimming alone saved 6.9 %.

Can I switch from monthly to lifetime later? Yes. The license is tied to your account; upgrading to the lifetime plan replaces the monthly charge.
